# 梯田與有機草生素材提示

使用內建 image_gen；透明 alpha PNG：terrain-terrace-eco.png。

Use case: stylized-concept. Production gameplay terrain-state atlas for a polished Taiwanese tea farming 16-bit pixel-art game. Reference is STYLE/CAMERA/GRID only. Create ONE transparent PNG atlas in EXACT 3 columns by 2 rows, 1536x1024, equal 512-square cells, no text, labels, UI, borders. Preserve same-size isometric diamond land footprints, cell center alignment, stone material, sunlight from upper left. Each sprite isolated with transparent margins. TOP LEFT: Qingxin Ganzai tea on unmistakable THREE DISTINCT STAIR-STEP TERRACES, each tea strip at visibly different elevation, thick vertical stone risers, exposed brown soil between tea shrubs. TOP MIDDLE: same three stair-step Ganzai terraces, but LUSH LOW GRASS covers exposed soil between tea rows; grass is clearly readable. TOP RIGHT: Qingxin Oolong, dark narrow leaves and subtle purple buds, on the same three very clear stair-step stone terraces, bare soil. BOTTOM LEFT: same Oolong stair-step terraces WITH LUSH GRASS between rows. BOTTOM MIDDLE: mature Ganzai tea rows WITH GRASS and wildflowers, a tiny brown insect-eating bird perched on a stake, TWO small butterflies hovering, an appealing lively organic tea garden; flat diamond platform, no stairs. BOTTOM RIGHT: same organic grassy plot but Oolong tea with dark narrower leaves and purplish young buds, small bird and butterflies. Terrace platforms must look like physical stairs with raised back step, middle step, lower front step, not merely painted rows or diagonal lines. A child should instantly recognize stepped engineering versus flat grass-covered organic field. Keep the six cells separate and at identical game-camera scale; alpha transparency preserved, nothing crosses cell boundaries.
